OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_en: The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances that are required for the node group. Valid values: 0 to 1000. If the number of pay-as-you-go instances is less than the value of this parameter, pay-as-you-go instances are preferentially created

OnDemandBaseCapacity.title: 按量实例个数的最小值。

OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_en: The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the instances that exceed the number specified by the OnDemandBaseCapacity parameter for the node group. Valid values: 0 to 100
OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_zh: 节点组满足最小按量实例OnDemandBaseCapacity要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100

SpotInstancePools.description_en: The number of instance types that are specified. Preemptible instances of multiple instance types that are provided at the lowest price are evenly created in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 10
SpotInstancePools.description_zh: 指定可用实例规格的个数，伸缩组将按成本最低的多个规格均衡创建抢占式实例。取值范围：0~10

DataDisk.description_en: The data cloud disk configuration, including the disk category, capacity, performance level (PL), and quantity
DataDisk.description_zh: 数据盘配置，包含磁盘类型、容量、性能级别和数量

Category.description_en:
The disk category. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: ESSD.
cloud: basic disk
Category.description_zh:
磁盘类型。取值范围：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。

PerformanceLevel.description_en:
The Settings for the performance level (PL) of the ESSD when it is used as a data cloud disk. Unlike a standard SSD, an ESSD allows you to specify different performance levels. Valid values:
PL0: Up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.
PL1: Up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.
PL2: Up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.
PL3: Up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS per disk.

Default value: PL1
PerformanceLevel.description_zh:
创建ESSD云盘作为数据盘使用时，设置云盘的性能等级。取值范围：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

默认值：PL1
PerformanceLevel.title: ESSD云盘性能级别。

SpotInstanceRemedy.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable spot instance replenishment. If this feature is enabled, the scaling group attempts to create new instances to replace spot instances that are about to be reclaimed when a system message about the reclamation is received. Valid values:
true: Enables spot instance replenishment.
false: Disables spot instance replenishment.

PrivatePoolOptions.description_en: The information about the private pool

MatchCriteria.description_en: The type of private pool that you want to use to start ECS instances. A private pool is generated when an elasticity assurance or a capacity reservation takes effect. You can select a private pool for starting ECS instances. Valid values: Open, Target, and None. If you set the parameter to Open, the system selects an open private pool to start instances. If no matching open private pools exist, the resources in the public pool are used. In this case, you do not need to specify the ID of the private pool. If you set the parameter to Target, the resources in the specified private pool are used to start ECS instances. If the specified private pool does not exist, ECS instances cannot be started. You must specify the ID of the private pool when you set the parameter to Target. If you set the parameter to None, the resources in private pools are not used to start instances. Default value: None
MatchCriteria.description_zh:
实例启动的私有池容量选项。弹性保障服务或容量预定服务在生效后会生成私有池容量，供实例启动时选择。取值范围：  
Open：开放模式。将自动匹配开放类型的私有池容量。如果没有符合条件的私有池容量，则使用公共池资源启动。该模式下无需设置PrivatePoolIds参数。
Target：指定模式。使用指定的私有池容量启动实例，如果该私有池容量不可用，则实例会启动失败。该模式下必须指定私有池 ID，即PrivatePoolIds参数为必填项。 
None：不使用模式。实例启动将不使用私有池容量。 默认值：None
MatchCriteria.title: 实例启动的私有池容量选项。弹性保障服务或容量预定服务在生效后会生成私有池容量，供实例启动时选择。取值范围：  Open：开放模式。将自动匹配开放类型的私有池容量。如果没有符合条件的私有池容量，则使用公共池资源启动。该模式下无需设置PrivatePoolOptions.Id参数。 Target：指定模式。使用指定的私有池容量启动实例，如果该私有池容量不可用，则实例会启动失败。该模式下必须指定私有池 ID，即PrivatePoolOptions.Id参数为必填项。 None：不使用模式。实例启动将不使用私有池容量。 默认值：None。

PrivatePoolIds.description_en: The IDs of the private pools

items.description_en: The ID of private pool. The ID of a private pool is the same as the ID of the elasticity assurance or capacity reservation that is associated with the private pool
items.description_zh: 私有池 ID。即弹性保障服务 ID 或容量预定服务 ID

PrivatePoolIds.title: 私有池 ID。即弹性保障服务 ID 或容量预定服务 ID。

PrivatePoolOptions.title: 私有池设置

LaunchExpirationTime.description_zh: 定时任务触发操作失败后，在此时间内重试。单位为秒，取值范围：0~3600
LaunchExpirationTime.title: 定时任务触发操作失败后，在此时间内重试。单位为秒，取值范围：0~3600。

LaunchTime.description_en: The time when the scaling rule is executed. This parameter is required. The value is a string in the HH:MM format
LaunchTime.description_zh: 伸缩规则执行时间。必填参数。HH:MM格式字符串
LaunchTime.title: 启动时间。

RecurrenceType.description_en:
The execution type of the time-based rule. Valid values:
DAILY: repeats daily.
WEEKLY: repeats weekly.
MONTHLY: repeats monthly
RecurrenceType.description_zh:
指定时间规则的执行类型。取值范围：
DAILY：按天重复。
WEEKLY：按周重复。
MONTHLY：按月重复
RecurrenceType.title: 指定时间规则的执行类型。

RecurrenceValue.description_en:
The recurrence value of the scheduled task. The specific value depends on the RecurrenceType setting.
If RecurrenceType is set to DAILY, you can specify only one value. Valid values: 1 to 31.
If RecurrenceType is set to WEEKLY, you can specify multiple values separated by commas (,). MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, and SUN represent Monday through Sunday. For example, MON,FRI,SUN represents Monday, Friday, and Sunday.
If RecurrenceType is set to MONTHLY, the format is A-B or A,B. Valid values of A and B: 1 to 31. If you use the A-B format, B must be greater than A
RecurrenceValue.description_zh:
重复执行定时任务的数值。具体取值取决于RecurrenceType设置。
RecurrenceType取DAILY时，只能填一个数值，取值范围：1~31。
RecurrenceType取WEEKLY时，可以填入多个值，填多个值时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。周一到周天分别用MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN代替。例如，MON,FRI,SUN代表周一、周五、周天。
RecurrenceType取MONTHLY时，格式为A-B或者A,B。A和B的取值范围都为1~31，如果使用A-B时B必须大于A
RecurrenceValue.title: 重复执行定时任务的数值。

StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间戳。必填参数。单位为毫秒

Statistics.title: 统计量名称。

Tags.description_en:
The list of metric partition tags.

For metrics with queue

Default value:

Tag key: queue_name. Value: root.

When you use metrics with a queue, you can set the queue_name tag to specify the queue. Ensure that you enter the full queue hierarchy name.

Example

Metric name: yarn_resourcemanager_queue_AvailableVCoresPercentage

Tag:
`queue_name: root.default.a`

For metrics with partition

Default value:
Tag key: none. Value: none.
For metrics with a partition, you must set the partition_name tag and explicitly specify the partition name.

Example

Metric name: yarn_cluster_availMemoryMBByPartition

Tag: `partition_name: DEFAULT_PARTITION`
Tags.description_zh:
指标分区标签列表

对于带 queue 的指标

默认值：

标签键（key）：queue_name。值（value）：root。

当您使用带有队列的指标时，您可以设置 queue_name 标签，指定所属的队列。确保输入完整的队列层级名称。

示例

指标名：yarn_resourcemanager_queue_AvailableVCoresPercentage

标签：
`queue_name: root.default.a`

对于带 partition 的指标

默认值：
标签键（key）：无。值（value）：无。
对于带有分区的指标，必须设置 partition_name 标签且明确指定分区名称。

示例

指标名：yarn_cluster_availMemoryMBByPartition

标签：`partition_name: DEFAULT_PARTITION`
Tags.title: 指标Tag。
